parsed.draft_response:
Hello, thanks for reporting this and for keeping it confidential. We understand your concern that a shared report URL created in one workspace may be accessible from another workspace when forwarded, which could indicate unintended cross-tenant access.

Because this is a security issue with high potential impact—and the report does not yet confirm data access/exfiltration—we have escalated this for human review by our security team.

To help the security team investigate quickly, could you please provide the minimum details below (redact any sensitive information as needed):
1) Product/service and the approximate time the behavior was observed (date/time + timezone).
2) What exact steps you took to reproduce it (including how you forwarded the URL and how you checked visibility in the other workspace).
3) Whether the other workspace user was able to *open the report and view/download data*, or whether it was only visible as a link/preview.
4) Whether the link is configurable (e.g., shared with specific recipients vs. general/shared link). If you know the sharing settings/permissions used when the link was created, please include that.
5) Any relevant identifiers for the affected workspaces/tenants (or anonymized IDs) and whether both users are authenticated in their respective workspaces.
6) If available: any audit/log evidence from the time of the test (e.g., share/link creation events, report view events, denied/allowed access logs).

Once we receive the above, we’ll use it to validate what happened and determine the appropriate next steps. We’ll follow up with you as soon as the security team has reviewed the case.
promised_actions: Escalate the report for human review by the security team.
Follow up after the security team reviews the provided details.
safety_notes: Do not confirm or deny cross-tenant access or data exfiltration; behavior is unconfirmed.
Avoid promising a fix, refund, SLA, or specific timeline.
Request minimum useful reproduction/impact details and any available logs while allowing redaction.
